name: Nintendo Campus Challenge 1992
summary: Nintendo Campus Challenge is a special cartridge used in the event of the same name where players compete under a time limit to get a high score across 3 SNES games; Super Mario World, F-Zero, and Pilotwings. In 1992, Nintendo held these competitions at universities in the United States, Europe, and Japan. The winner from each campus won a SNES with the headlining games bundled in as well as a $10,000 cash prize. There are only 3 cartridges rumored to be in circulation.
